war_summary: War 139 is on day 101 with no winner. Colonials hold a commanding strategic lead, controlling 189 bases to the Wardens' 67 across 40 regions (no neutral bases). The front is defined by a handful of intensely contested regions where casualties are in the thousands per hour and bases are actively flipping. Endless Shore (41 events/24h, ~4,800 combined casualties/hr), Oarbreaker (50 events/24h, ~48 combined casualties/hr but high flip volume), Clahstra (24 events/24h, ~1,800 combined casualties/hr), Godcrofts (17 events/24h, ~70 combined casualties/hr), Stlican Shelf (21 events/24h, ~200 combined casualties/hr), and Callahans Passage (3 events/24h but ~2,700 combined casualties/hr accelerating) are the primary active theaters. Marban Hollow and Olavis Wake show massive accelerating casualty rates (2,000+/hr) but surprisingly low recent event counts, suggesting heavy fighting around existing bases rather than captures. Mooring County (18 events/24h) and Callums Cape (extreme casualty spike: ~3,200 combined casualties in last 2h) are also significant. The Wardens hold quiet northern regions (Basin Sionnach, Clanshead Valley, Howl County, Viper Pit, Weathered Expanse, Speaking Woods, Reaching Trail) but Speaking Woods shows sharply cooling casualties after a heavy 6h period. Large Colonial rear areas (Deadlands, Drowned Vale, Allods Bight, Farranac Coast, etc.) are quiet.
